verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a built-in AI Chat that can be given blocks/notes as context to answer questions, AI-driven property auto-fill for drafting, and AI image analysis, plus explicit opt-in controls so no data reaches third-party AI unless activated. However, summarization is not explicitly documented as a distinct capability and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of the AI assistant's quality or grounding accuracy. missing for 10: explicit summarization feature, independent user testimony on AI assistant performance/grounding.
